check: June has 30 − 8 = 22 listening days, and together they play 10 + (10 − 2) = 18 songs per day. Their total is 22 × 18 = 396 songs.
error_description: The solution treats four weeks as four listening days instead of 20 weekdays. This produces incorrect monthly totals of 60 and 48 songs and an incorrect combined total of 108.
